upstream.attribution: Vienna 4x22 Piano Corpus, Werner Goebl; symbolic score updates by CPJKU

selection: All non-Mozart works in the frozen upstream inventory; no filtering using predictions or truth.

inputs.primaryRecognitionInput: rendered PDF, complete excerpt without cropping or notation edits
inputs.originalPdfRole: source-admission audit, not a replacement chosen after observing results
inputs.hashes: Materialization MUST record SHA-256 for original PDFs, MusicXML and rendered PDFs before truth evaluation.

execution.configuration: current production adapter defaults; no decoder, context or model ablations
execution.allSourceRejectedAction: Record not-evaluable and do not spend inference budget or claim a no-regression pass.

gates.wholeWorkMetrics: Pitch TP/F1 and strict staff-measure match MUST NOT regress for any evaluated work.
gates.failurePolicy: Any unmet gate prevents default activation. Rejected works stay in the denominator and evidence report.
gates.tuningPolicy: No candidate changes after inspecting these inputs or truth may be evaluated as independent using this protocol.
